text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Defeat—I have felt the weight of destiny's 
unyielding chains. And it was my archrival 
who seized the Tenno Sho (Autumn) shield!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet now, I know the true identity of the 
warrior of destiny. She is—the center of 
the era. She is about to become fate 
itself!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I declared it! I shall charge against the 
destiny of the world. With the twin wheels 
of the Yasuda Kinen and the Takarazuka 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Our sortie shook the world. Yet, without 
hardship, there is no challenge! The wheel 
of fate has begun to turn once more!
